tagline: Bridge personal task capture in Todoist with team project management in ClickUp
metaTitle: Todoist + ClickUp Integration: Personal and Team Tasks
metaDescription: Capture tasks in Todoist and run them in ClickUp, with completion synced both ways. GAIA pulls in your assignments. See the setup steps.
intro:
ClickUp offers team project management with rich hierarchy, custom fields, and reporting capabilities. Todoist is the personal task manager individuals reach for when they need fast, frictionless capture. Many professionals collaborate with their team in the project manager but still rely on the personal one for their own GTD-style inbox, creating a persistent gap between personal intentions and team-visible commitments.

GAIA bridges this gap by acting as an intelligent relay between the two. Personal action items captured in Todoist can be promoted to ClickUp tasks in the right list and with the right metadata when they need team visibility. Tasks assigned to you flow into your personal inbox so your review happens in one place. Status updates propagate in both directions so neither side falls behind.

This suits individual contributors who want a personal capture tool without abandoning the workflows their team depends on, and managers who track their own actions privately but need those actions visible to the team for accountability.

useCases.title: Capture in Todoist, execute in ClickUp
useCases.description: Use the fast-capture interface during meetings or on the go, then let GAIA automatically promote relevant tasks to the team workspace with the correct space, folder, list, and assignee pre-filled based on project context.

useCases.title: Pull assigned ClickUp tasks into Todoist
useCases.description: GAIA monitors for tasks assigned to you and mirrors them into your personal inbox with due dates and priorities, so your daily review can happen entirely in one app without switching to the team workspace.

useCases.title: Sync task completion in both directions
useCases.description: When you check off a task on one side, GAIA marks the linked task complete on the other, and vice versa, ensuring your team's project views always reflect your actual progress without manual double-entry.

useCases.title: Weekly workload overview
useCases.description: Each week GAIA generates a combined view of your personal tasks and team assignments grouped by project, helping you spot overload and balance commitments before deadlines arrive.

useCases.title: Meeting action item distribution
useCases.description: After a meeting where actions are captured personally, GAIA distributes the relevant items to the appropriate lists for each team member, turning meeting notes into trackable team tasks automatically.

howItWorks.step: Connect Todoist and ClickUp to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate both accounts in GAIA's integration settings. GAIA uses OAuth for secure access and only requests permissions for the workspaces and projects you specify.

howItWorks.step: Map projects and define promotion rules
howItWorks.description: Define which personal projects correspond to team spaces and lists. Set rules for when GAIA should automatically promote a task to the team workspace, for example, tasks tagged with a specific label or assigned a certain priority.

howItWorks.step: GAIA syncs tasks in both directions continuously
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both sides for new tasks, assignments, and status changes, propagating updates automatically so your personal and team views always reflect the same reality.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support ClickUp's custom task statuses?
faqs.answer: Yes. During setup you can map the personal app's completion states to any custom status in your team workspace. This means tasks can progress through your team's specific workflow stages as they move between tools.

faqs.question: Can I sync only specific Todoist projects?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You choose exactly which projects participate in the sync. Personal projects like shopping lists or private goals stay in the personal app only, while work projects are bridged to the relevant team spaces.

faqs.question: Will GAIA create duplicate tasks if both tools update at the same time?
faqs.answer: GAIA uses unique link identifiers to track the relationship between paired tasks. It applies last-write-wins logic with a short debounce window to resolve simultaneous edits, and alerts you when a conflict cannot be resolved automatically.
